definitions.gloss: to be exposed; to come to light; to be revealed; to become apparent
definitions.explanation: For something hidden, negative, or problematic to become visible or known. Almost always used for negative things — flaws, weaknesses, scandals, contradictions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題点|もんだいてん}→問題点：20619_mondaiten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{露呈|ろてい}した。
⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弱点|じゃくてん}→弱点：12497_jakuten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{露呈|ろてい}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The organization's weaknesses are being exposed one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不備|ふび}→不備：07599_fubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{露呈|ろてい}し、⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まった→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: Deficiencies in disaster response were exposed, and criticism of the government intensified.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost exclusively used for negative things — problems, weaknesses, flaws, contradictions, or incompetence. Rarely if ever used for positive revelations. Common in news reports and formal analysis.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{露呈|ろてい}する (problems are exposed)
- ⟦{弱点|じゃくてん}→弱点：12497_jakuten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{露呈|ろてい}する (weaknesses come to light)
- ⟦{矛盾|むじゅん}→矛盾：05215_mujun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{露呈|ろてい}する (contradictions are revealed)
- ⟦{限界|げんかい}→限界：02715_genkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{露呈|ろてい}する (limitations are exposed)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発覚|はっかく}する→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧: to be discovered — for scandals or wrongdoing specifically
- ⟦{暴露|ばくろ}する→暴露する：18209_bakurosuru⟧: to expose, to reveal — actively revealing secrets (transitive)
